rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A Docker CLI plugin that extends the Docker command line to manage MCP server discovery, deployment, and lifecycle. Provides catalog management for browsing and organizing servers, container-based deployment, credential and secret management with OAuth authentication support, and access control policy enforcement. Integrates with Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Zed, Kiro, and Continue.dev. Supports configuration backup and restoration and OCI registry compatibility for container images.
